name: Regular Show: Best Park in the Universe Vita
author: clickbate
description: A PS Vita port of the Android game Regular Show: Best Park in the Universe. This side-scrolling beat 'em up features Mordecai and Rigby battling enemies with combo attacks and unlockable abilities. Touch screen gestures have been changed to hardware vita buttons/sticks.
requirements:
- libshacccg.suprx
- kubridge.skprx
- Game Data Files: Android
